solutions.title: See how we help drive more revenue and operational efficiency.
solutions.description: Marketing, sales, support and operations: a platform, AI and specialists working to turn bottlenecks into results.

items.label: Marketing
items.title: More revenue from your campaigns. Fewer leads left unanswered.
items.answer: You invest in generating interest, but contacts go cold, nurturing falls behind, and it is not always clear what turned into a sale. We connect campaigns, conversations and deals to turn that interest into revenue, with AI and specialists working alongside you.
bullets: Know what brings results: track each lead from its source to the deal and revenue.
Keep interest alive: nurturing, personalization and automatic follow-ups.
Improve the handover to sales: opportunities with history and campaign context.
items.alt: Real yapt. lead list showing source, journey, linked deal and qualification score

items.label: Sales
items.title: More deals moving forward. Fewer opportunities going cold.
items.answer: Leads waiting for replies, sellers searching for information and follow-ups relying on memory reduce conversion. yapt. connects WhatsApp CRM, AI agents and pipeline management to prepare opportunities and move deals forward.
bullets: Start the conversation prepared: AI that qualifies leads, interprets documents and audio, and summarizes context.
Keep negotiations moving: connected reply suggestions, activities and follow-ups.
See where sales get stuck: pipeline, targets and business information in the same operation.
items.alt: A real yapt. pipeline with deals, values, revenue forecasts, and targets

items.label: Support
items.title: Resolve more. Make customers repeat less.
items.answer: Customers repeat their story, agents search for answers and tickets change hands without moving forward. AI for customer service connects history, tickets and knowledge to support your team and keep service moving toward resolution.
bullets: Combine customer context with AI for L1 and L2: connect history, tickets and customer data, with answers grounded in your documentation and actions in your systems.
Reduce handling times with intelligent management: organize queues, teams, priorities and customer portfolios to balance workload and improve service efficiency.
Hand off with context and track results: the team receives the AI summary and conversation history; reports show resolution, response times, productivity and bottlenecks.
items.alt: Real support metrics in yapt. showing resolution and service times

items.label: Operations
items.alt: Actual yapt. queue health screen with waiting conversations, longest wait and available agents by department
items.title: Less rework. More capacity to deliver.
items.answer: Growing queues, overloaded teams and scattered information make it difficult to know where to act. Apply artificial intelligence for operations, process automation and system integration to improve work across teams, with specialists available when needed.
bullets: See where work stops: queues, deadlines, capacity and productivity in one view.
Reduce manual work: request routing and processes connected to existing systems.
Track improvement: owners, indicators and visibility into the effect of each change.

foundation.title: Intelligence to converse, guide, and get things done.

examples.label: Sales agent
examples.prompt: I want an AI that understands the lead, qualifies them, and passes the context to the salesperson.
examples.response: Let's build it. It can use your knowledge, follow the qualification journey, and hand the conversation over to the right team.

examples.label: Operator mentor
examples.prompt: I want a copilot that helps my team resolve tickets without losing context.
examples.response: Let's connect your procedures and history. The mentor can suggest replies and guide the next action while the person handles the service interaction.

examples.label: Intelligent routing
examples.prompt: I want each conversation to reach someone who can resolve it, considering the topic, urgency, and team capacity.
examples.response: Let's combine your operating rules with AI analysis to understand the context and route conversations. You define the criteria and test before publishing.

examples.label: Integration and data
examples.prompt: I want to look up an order in my system, show the data during service, and let the agent update authorized information.
examples.response: Let's define access and the actions the connection can perform. You test lookups and updates, choose when an action needs approval, and decide when to publish.

cards.label: Artificial intelligence
cards.title: AI to serve, guide, and act.
cards.text: From the first conversation to the next decision, AI joins the work with your company's context.
bullets: Agents handle conversations, qualify opportunities, and carry out authorized actions.
Mentors and copilots suggest replies and next steps using history and company knowledge.
Lead scoring and sentiment analysis help the team prioritize.

cards.label: Automations
cards.title: Every conversation takes the next step.
cards.text: Operating rules and AI analysis turn what happens in a conversation into next steps.
bullets: Route conversations by profile, capacity, and urgency.
Schedule follow-ups, tasks, and stage changes at the defined time.
Carry actions into connected systems to keep the process moving.

cards.label: Data in context
cards.title: The right context when it's time to resolve.
cards.text: Bring information from your company's systems into the place where conversations and work happen.
bullets: Orders, customer records, and financial information in the operator's workspace.
The same context available for AI to consult and carry out authorized actions.
Data that feeds automations and operational indicators.

cards.label: Integrations
cards.title: From what you describe to a connected system.
cards.text: Talk to the Builder in yaAgents to create tools, integrations, and workflows that look up or update information in systems.
bullets: Define which data and actions each connection can access.
Test the behavior and choose when to publish.
Work with specialists to design and connect each scenario.
